versions.changelog:
v1.2.0 is a documentation and usability update.

- Rewrote documentation in Chinese, including concise quickstart and usage examples.
- Organized usage scenarios: arXiv/PDF/title input, comparison, reproduction checklist, etc.
- Clarified dependency installation (only pymupdf required; all others built-in for macOS).
- Restructured workflow and rules for step-by-step clarity, prioritizing main user tasks.
- Updated dependency table and local/HTML output steps for easier troubleshooting and guidance.

- Initial release of the mli-paper-reading skill for academic paper reading and literature analysis, inspired by Li Mu's three-pass reading method.
- Supports processing papers via arXiv link, PDF file, DOI, or title, with automatic metadata extraction.
- Implements triage (five C’s), three-pass reading (overview, deep read, argument reconstruction), and critical analysis including evidence and experimental checks.
- Generates self-contained HTML reading notes with embedded figures, MathJax-rendered formulas, and local server/browser integration.
- Provides detailed setup instructions and dependency checks for smooth workflow on macOS and Linux.
- Output supports local note browsing with fallbacks for offline viewing.
